extracted.intended_audience: photojournalists and photographers submitting to the Pictures of the Year (POY) competition
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and category/prize rules for submitting and winning work in the Pictures of the Year international photography competition (POY83). Covers contest categories, prizes, and requirements for winning entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual category winners (1st)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied to individual category winners; implies a clear first-place designation per category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finalist and Award of Excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: Finalist and Award of Excellence — PDF Certificate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finalists and Awards of Excellence receive PDF certificates rather than physical trophies; used as recognition levels below 1st place.

rubrics_metrics.name: $1,000 cash prizes & Tiffany crystal trophy (top awards)
rubrics_metrics.description: $1,000 cash prizes & Tiffany crystal trophy awarded to: International Photographer of the Year; Photographer of the Year; World Understanding Award; Community Awareness Award; Environmental Vision Award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These named awards carry both a cash prize and a Tiffany crystal trophy, identifying them as the competition's top honors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tiffany crystal trophy (additional named awards)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tiffany crystal trophy awarded to: Sports Photographer of the Year; Documentary Storyteller of the Year; Photography Book of the Year; Visual Editor of the Year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These significant category-level honors receive a Tiffany crystal trophy (no cash prize mentioned).

rubrics_metrics.name: Angus McDougall Excellence in Editing Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Winner hosts a sterling silver trophy for one year and receives free tuition to the Missouri Photo Workshop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This award includes a traveling trophy (hosted for one year) and an educational prize (tuition).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement for winning entries: high-resolution and digital files
rubrics_metrics.description: For winning entries, POY requires high resolution copies of the images and digital files of the films and online entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Winners must provide high-res image files and original digital media for verification, reproduction, and archiving; this is a submission requirement post-selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Announcement and verification process for winners
rubrics_metrics.description: All winners will be posted to social media soon after the jury makes its decisions. An official announcement will be made after the competition ends and the results are verified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public posting is provisional until results are verified; there is an official announcement step after verification.
